verdict.rationale: Smithery's own CLI documents adding MCP servers ('smithery mcp add <url>') and calling their tools ('smithery tool call'), and its Connect docs describe connecting to MCP servers and aggregating their tools. However, the hosted Connect/API services, along with the service-tied CLI and SDK versions, were shut down on 2026-10-31. That leaves only the maintained CLI's commands as current documentation, with no hands-on proof they work against the public registry. missing for 10: a live hosted connection/tool-calling service after shutdown, hands-on corroboration that the post-shutdown CLI's tool calls work, and in-depth current docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect to multiple servers and aggregate their tools
